justification: User-facing table and clause-list wording on the address page, no database or API change, but it decides what a reader sees next to every plan figure.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the table still prints the unchecked badge, a clause number, Not in our data, or a May apply tag
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Run against the old source files: Tests: 6 failed, 44 passed, 50 total, including the new no-unproven-citation and see-clauses-below tests.

pre_impl.existing_data: No data change. The table reads the same controls from the structured controls route and the same stored brief rows as before; only labels change.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The handoff said the table seemed to skip the hide-unproven path. Reading the code showed the badge is hard-coded unchecked on every row, so nothing was being skipped.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new component. The brief fetch moved into a hook so the table and the clause lists share one SWR request and the table can know which rows have clauses.

functions.name: EntryCells
functions.input: One summary entry holding figure, document, page, link and words.
functions.output: Table cells with document, page link and optional words, never a clause number.
functions.if_none: A missing document or words renders an empty cell, never filler text.

functions.name: RowView
functions.input: A summary row and whether its clauses are listed below the table.
functions.output: Either the figure rows or one row saying see the clauses below or not found.
functions.if_none: No clause flag given means the original not-found text is shown.

functions.name: usePlanBriefRows
functions.input: Council, project type, zone and the set of rows already proven.
functions.output: Shaped brief rows, or null when off, loading, failed or nothing built.
functions.if_none: Null means the table keeps its not-found text and no clause list shows.

break_it.scenario: the brief flag is off or the fetch fails while the table loads
break_it.what_happens: A row could say see the clauses below when no clauses are shown.
break_it.how: the see-below text needs the hook to return rows with items for that key; null keeps the not-found text

break_it.scenario: a control has no page number in the stored row
break_it.what_happens: The link text could show an empty or undefined page label.
break_it.how: without a page the link text falls back to Open the plan

break_it.scenario: a clause item has verdict APPLIES versus any other value
break_it.what_happens: The wrong tag could show, or no tag where one is expected.
break_it.how: only APPLIES renders the tag, all other values render none, covered by the brief test

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - after deploy open one address and check no unchecked badge, no Not in our data, no May apply.
